title: No decrypt test for OpenSSL-encrypted KARI content
description: Tests I and J encrypt with our code and verify with OpenSSL, proving our encryption is correct. But there is no test where OpenSSL encrypts to a P-256 or P-384 recipient and our code decrypts via DecryptionKey::agree_ecdh. The full KARI decrypt path (ECDH → X9.63 KDF → AES-KW unwrap → AES-CBC decrypt) is exercised only through Test K's stub, which refuses ECDH. A real end-to-end KARI decrypt oracle test is missing: openssl cms -encrypt to a P-256/P-384 cert, then decrypt() with our agree_ecdh implementation. If the KDF or key-wrap is wrong, our tests would not catch it.
close_reason: Fixed: EC384 cert regenerated with valid dates (notBefore < notAfter); KARI P-256 oracle test added with Python-generated fixture verified by OpenSSL decrypt
